# Skill Doctor Lite — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Local-first skill supply-chain linter CLI + interactive web demo. 25-rule versioned catalog; severity-triaged PASS/FAIL verdicts (no grades); machine-readable reports pin rules_version. Web demo parity-verified finding-for-finding (33/33) against the Python CLI. Stdlib-only, no network, no telemetry.
